items.title: Greg Minnaar On Why Some Riders NEVER Reach the Top | Just Ride
items.description:
In this episode of Just Ride, Rob Warner and Eliot Jackson sit down with Greg Minnaar to talk about life after racing, building a modern World Cup downhill team, and what it really takes to stay competitive at the highest level of the sport.

From bike setup and rider development to data analysis, team structure, and managing pressure, Greg shares how downhill racing has evolved over the years and how teams are constantly searching for new ways to gain an edge. He also opens up about transitioning from athlete to team director and helping guide the next generation of riders.

The conversation dives deep into World Cup racing, Hardline, the future of downhill MTB, legendary rivalries, and the mindset behind one of the most successful careers the sport has ever seen.

items.title: 2025 Downhill Season Recap | WHOOP UCI MTB World Series
items.description:
The 2025 UCI Downhill World Cup season didn’t pretend to be anything other than chaos and drama, steep tracks, varied conditions, and races decided by the smallest margins.

The rivalries carried it. Vali Höll vs Gracey Hemstreet was all-out, while Jackson Goldstone vs Loïc Bruni felt like watching two different generations of rider collide, raw speed against absolute control.

The 2026 season is here! Same names, new contenders, faster tracks, and still just one run to get it right.

items.title: FOX starts off the 2026 Downhill World Cup Season in South Korea with Asa Vermette – The Setup | FOX
items.description:
Episode two of The Setup takes us to Pyeongchang, South Korea for the opening round of the UCI World Series. It’s been more than two decades since the last UCI Downhill World Cup was held in Asia, and with a brand-new venue featuring multiple lines and plenty of variety, riders will have their work cut out for them as they sort out the right setup for this amazingly unpredictable track.

After a long offseason, this week feels a bit like a family reunion. Remi catches up with the teams, athletes, and of course the FOX race crew as everyone settles back into race week. From suspension setup, track walk analysis and last-minute bike changes, the pits are full of constant fine-tuning. 

On a fresh track like this, the FOX team is fully locked in to make sure every detail is refine before race runs begin.

Host: Remi Gauvin
Video: Brooks Curran

#FOX #RideFox #TheSetup

FIRST RIDE ON THE NEW FOX 40'S AT DYFI BIKE PARK!
items.description:
We're back in Wales testing out the new Fox 40's and we're letting you in on how we set up the forks for my riding. The new Fox addition feels amazing and I cant wait to get them to World cup!

https://ridefox.com/pages/fox-40

Shot on @DJI & @Sony
